intentions: Allow creation of new products with basic attributes such as name, category, and initial stock quantity
Enable reading (retrieving) of product details by product ID or other identifiers
Support updating existing product information including name, category, or stock levels
Provide a bulk update operation to modify the stock quantity of multiple products simultaneously
Ensure that the bulk update operation is atomic—either all changes succeed or none are applied
Maintain data consistency and integrity through transactional behavior
Handle errors gracefully during CRUD operations and bulk updates, rolling back changes if any step fails
